summary: IST-boundary regression for Lead follow-up: past-date validation and dashboard followups_today both use extras.ist_today_str(). Added /app/backend/tests/test_followup_ist.py (10 targeted tests). Ran alongside existing follow-up regression: TestLeadActions.test_followup_past_rejected_future_ok and TestIssue11FollowupToday. All 10 passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py FOLLOW_UP past-date guard (line ~531) now correctly uses datetime.fromisoformat(ist_today_str()).date(); could be simplified to `date.fromisoformat(ist_today_str())` to avoid intermediate datetime, but functionally correct.

dashboard followups_today() (line ~1279) fetches ALL lead_followups docs (find({}).to_list(5000)) then filters in Python — scales poorly. Consider Mongo-side filter: {'followup_date': {'$regex': f'^{ist_today}'}} plus lead_id $in currently-FOLLOW_UP leads.

Sibling `today` (UTC) at line 1277 is still used by site-visit/complaint metrics — intentionally out of scope per problem statement, but this is a latent IST inconsistency across the same dashboard payload.
list_leads ?followup=today already uses ist_today_str() — verified unchanged and consistent with the fix.
seed_data_creation: Created transient TEST_IST_* leads and TESTFU_* lead_followups; module-scope autouse fixture cleans them up after test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_followup_ist.py covers: (a) FOLLOW_UP action accepts IST-today, rejects IST-yesterday, accepts future, still requires both date+remarks; (b) dashboard followups_today (top-level key on LEAD dashboard schema) counts IST-today, ignores IST-yesterday, increments by exactly 1 per additional IST-today row; (c) consistency with GET /api/leads?followup=today; (d) remarks + followup_date persisted. Note LEAD dashboard schema is FLAT (followups_today top-level, not under 'leads'). At test-run wall clock UTC==IST date, so the UTC-differs branch in test_boundary_ist_vs_utc is skipped with an info log — the negative/positive DB-level assertions still definitively prove IST usage. To force the UTC/IST boundary deterministically in future, freezegun on server-imported ist_today_str is not viable against the running supervisor process; would need in-process TestClient.
rca of the issue: N/A - this was validation of a targeted fix, not a bug hunt. Fix verified: FOLLOW_UP past-date check and dashboard followups_today now both key off extras.ist_today_str() (IST calendar) rather than UTC.
